submitted.rationale: Across the five measurements, EQE rises steadily with Sb fraction: ~0 at x=0.22, 0.0069% at 0.51, 0.0116% at 0.65, 0.0082% at 0.78, and 0.043% at 0.855 (index 27, the highest-Sb end of the line). XRD at x=0.62 and 0.78 shows the same rutile-type phase, so the jump at the Sb-rich end is probably from more Sb, not a phase change. All EQE values are very low (well under 0.1%), which fits photons at 2.4 eV being near or below the gap of these wide-gap oxides.

rejected.reason: The In-rich In11Sb3O24 region gave essentially zero EQE (-1e-5%).
The InSbO4 composition gave 0.0069%, about 6x lower than index 27.
The In3Sb5O12 region gave 0.0116%, lower than index 27.
Measured 0.0082%; same rutile phase as index 18, lower than index 27.
